pages.name: Friesian
pages.text: The dramatic all-black horse of the Dutch lowlands. Tall, powerful, and almost always show-ready — there's no mistaking one for any other breed.

pages.title: Coat
pages.text: $(li)Black$()$(br2)Only one coat. Friesians are always black.
